description: Owner of an NFT on zkSync Era: the wallet that holds one ERC-721 token id right now (ownerOf), plus the collection's name and symbol. Use to verify who holds an NFT before a trade, a mint gate or an airdrop; for how many a wallet holds use zksync_nft_balance, for the token's metadata zksync_nft_metadata. A missing contract is 404, a token that does not exist 422, both uncharged. Example: contract=0x0616e5762c1E7Dc3723c50663dF10a162D690a86, tokenId=1. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: zksync_nft_owner
title: NFT owner, zkSync
